rules.when: Research that needs current external facts: breaking news, current events, today's market or product state, release versions, or up-to-date documentation.
rules.why: Every candidate has a live web search tool. Research is not coding, so a weak coding score does not matter here.

rules.when: Task needs generated images or visual assets: icons, illustrations, logos, mockup art, placeholder imagery.
rules.why: Only Pi with the pi-antigravity extension can generate images.

rules.when: Review, audit, or second opinion on a diff/PR/design another crewmate produced. Not for writing the fix.
rules.why: Prefer a different model family than the author's. Fable 5.1 added by the captain 2026-10-16; quota-axi bounds it by the shared five-hour and seven-day Claude windows plus its own Fable week (scope model:fable), so it adds capability, not extra Claude capacity. Antigravity Opus runs only in low-volume tiers because its quota pool is small. Sol runs at xhigh, not high: Sol high scores below Sol medium.

rules.when: Recon-only, file gathering, narrow lookup, or a trivial mechanical edit (rename, format sweep, typo fix). Not for research that needs current external facts.
rules.why: Cheapest models; coding quality barely matters for this work.

rules.when: Ordinary implementation, bounded bug fix, tests, everyday coding with a clear path.
rules.why: Claude is deliberately left out: it is reserved for the hardest tier, and Codex carries the volume.

rules.when: Large/ambiguous multi-file change, risky refactor, work holding many moving parts at once.
rules.why: Claude is deliberately left out: it is reserved for the hardest tier. Sol xhigh scores below the Claude max models but is far cheaper and faster; Grok xhigh scores lower still and is the fallback when Codex is exhausted. Sol runs at xhigh, not high: Sol high scores below Sol medium.

rules.when: Hardest available work: root-cause investigation, architecture, ambiguous design, or already failed on the workhorse tier.
rules.why: Claude only: this tier is where Claude is reserved. Fable 5.1 was added by the captain on 2026-10-16 and verified live on both the claude CLI and Pi's claude-bridge that day; quota-axi bounds it by the shared five-hour and seven-day Claude windows plus its own Fable week (scope model:fable), so it adds capability, not extra Claude capacity. Antigravity Opus runs at high, Antigravity's ceiling. It runs only in low-volume tiers because its quota pool is small.
